meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 自动执行版本发布流程：更新全部配置文件的版本号，构建同步，提交推送，打标签，创建GitHub发布，重生成变更日志，发Discord通知；npm发布交给操作者手动做。
howto.when: 当用户要求发布新版本、升级版本号或补丁修复时触发。

say.note: 会自动走完整发布流程

say.text: 发布一个minor版本，更新日志和标签
say.note: 会生成变更日志并推送GitHub发布

say.text: 刚才的修复功能够了，帮我打补丁版本

howto.what_en: Automates the version release flow: updates version strings in all config files, runs build-and-sync, commits and pushes with a git tag, creates a GitHub release, regenerates the changelog, and sends a Discord notification. NPM publishing is left to the human operator to run manually.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to release a new version, bump the version number, or create a patch/minor/major release.

say_en.text: Bump the version to 1.2.4 and release it.
say_en.note: Runs the full release workflow automatically.

say_en.text: Do a minor release, updating logs and tags.
say_en.note: Generates a changelog and pushes a GitHub release.

say_en.text: Create a patch release for the recent fix.
